name: Ajulemic acid
summary: Lenabasum is a synthetic cannabinoid that shows anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory effects in pre-clinical studies without causing a subjective "high". Although its design was inspired by a metabolite of delta-9-THC known as delta-9-THC-11-oic acid, lenabasum is an analog of the delta-8-THC metabolite delta-8-THC-11-oic acid.

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of action is through activation of the CB2 receptor leading to production of specialized proresolving eicosanoids such as lipoxin A4 and prostaglandin J2.

uses.text: It is being developed for the treatment of inflammatory and fibrotic conditions such as systemic sclerosis, dermatomyositis and cystic fibrosis. It does not share the anti-emetic effects of some other cannabinoids, but may be useful for treating chronic inflammatory conditions where inflammation fails to resolve. Development since been discontinued.

sideEffects.text: Side effects include dry mouth, tiredness, and dizziness.

fact.en: Ajulemic acid, now called lenabasum, was modelled on a breakdown product of THC that the body makes naturally. Chemists tweaked it so that it calms inflammation without producing a high.
fact.zh: Ajulemic acid（現名 lenabasum）是以 THC 在體內自然分解產生的代謝物為藍本設計的。化學家調整了它的結構，使它能平息發炎，卻不會讓人感到「嗨」。
fact.zhHans: Ajulemic acid（现名 lenabasum）是以 THC 在体内自然分解产生的代谢物为蓝本设计的。化学家调整了它的结构，使它能平息发炎，却不会让人感到「嗨」。
